mission_06: Use np.random.randn(n) to generate standard normal samples.
np.cov(X, Y) returns the 2x2 covariance matrix.
np.corrcoef(X, Y) returns the 2x2 correlation matrix.
For W = aX + b: Cov(X, W) = a * Var(X) and corr(X, W) = sign(a).
Cov(X, Y+Z) = Cov(X,Y) + Cov(X,Z) when Z is independent of X.
